patterns.note: Full-screen, scroll-snapping hero sections with distinct content and background imagery that transition on scroll, creating an immersive product showcase.
Very large, bold sans-serif headings are used for hero and key section titles, creating strong visual impact and hierarchy.
A vibrant, warm accent color (peach/orange) is used prominently for CTAs and brand elements, contrasting against a mostly dark (black/dark grey) or light (white/light grey) neutral palette.

The hero section features a full-screen, scroll-triggered content and background image transition, where each 'slide' snaps into view as the user scrolls, revealing new product information. The main navigation remains sticky at the top.
Dedicated 'benefits' sections utilize a two-column layout with bullet points and a large, centered heading, providing clear and concise information.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-screen, scroll-snapping hero experience where scrolling triggers a complete visual transition to the next content slide, including new text and background imagery, likely achieved with a JavaScript library like locomotive-scroll.
Content sections often use a dark, semi-transparent overlay on background images to ensure high contrast for white text.
Text and image blocks are frequently arranged in an asymmetrical, split-screen layout, often with large, bold typography on one side and supporting imagery on the other.

design_tokens.type_scale: Hero headings are extremely large and bold (up to ~8x body text), creating a dramatic visual statement, while body text is clean and highly readable. Smaller, all-caps labels provide contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and image corners have a slight curve).
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and major section breaks, providing ample breathing room around content. Some tighter grids are used for product displays.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the immersive, full-screen scroll-snapping hero experience that dynamically transitions between different product showcases with bold typography and changing background imagery. This creates a highly engaging and interactive introduction to the brand's offerings.
